notes: Normal project trust and exact hook review were used in a disposable Git project launched from its subdirectory.
Only fixture-related context measurements, calls and actual tool results are retained; no account/authentication/base-instruction/reasoning records.
The host kept its existing authentication/trust home and global Claude policy location; capy configuration was isolated, the knowledge key synthetic, and the vault key unset.
HTTP-shaped commands contain an unexecuted dead branch and made no HTTP request.
The two independent fixture hooks only emit startup context or deny the synthetic external marker.
The child full-history fork includes inherited parent context before an additional 3532-byte capy child block.
An initial parent-evidence check expired during ordinary approval delay. The later A/B handoffs verified both isolation directions within 60 seconds without changing the TTL.
The cleanup receipt described child completion as unverified, but its retained actual McpToolCall completed result and populated child observation independently prove the execute succeeded.
The live binary contains dac9fd9 runtime code; Task 5 changes only help text/documentation, validated with a separate final build.
